say:7:1660218005:0.text: Is that so? Because from where I'm standing, you're the ones who dragged us into this absurd dream in the first place.
say:7:1660218005:0.source_cn: 带来破坏的，明明是你们！是你们把我们弄进了这场荒诞的梦里。

say:9:1660218006:0.text: People are cursed because of your little dream trick. No offense, but this doesn't scream "good intentions".
say:9:1660218006:0.source_cn: 许多人因此感染上了那些梦境里的诅咒，恕我直言，这并不像...

say:11:1660218007:0.text: It's not a trick. It's protection. You just don't see it.
say:11:1660218007:0.source_cn: 梦境是一种保护，你们不懂。

say:12:1660218008:0.text: Nothing in here can hurt you. The curses aren't real. You're all just too stuck in reality to understand.
say:12:1660218008:0.source_cn: 梦里的诅咒没有伤害，你们不懂。

choice_prompt:13:1660218008.text: Nothing in here can hurt you. The curses aren't real. You're all just too stuck in reality to understand.
choice_prompt:13:1660218008.source_cn: 梦里的诅咒没有伤害，你们不懂。

say:14:1660218009:1.text: We didn't do this for fun. The dream was necessary. It kept everyone safe.
say:14:1660218009:1.source_cn: 我们制造梦境，是出于安全起见，这是必要的。

say:15:1660218010:1.text: The nightmare came. And only a shared dream could hold it back. We didn't have a choice.
say:15:1660218010:1.source_cn: 梦魇来了，众人的梦境能抵御梦魇，这是必要的。

choice_prompt:16:1660218010.text: The nightmare came. And only a shared dream could hold it back. We didn't have a choice.
choice_prompt:16:1660218010.source_cn: 梦魇来了，众人的梦境能抵御梦魇，这是必要的。

say:17:1660218011:1.text: Aurora was asleep. We just... borrowed a little of her power.
say:17:1660218011:1.source_cn: 奥萝拉睡着了，我们借来了一点力量。

say:18:1660218012:1.text: And it worked. No one's fighting. No one's getting hurt!
say:18:1660218012:1.source_cn: 大家只要在梦里，就不会再有纷争！

say:19:1660218013:0.text: So come on. Dream with us!

say:20:1660218014:0.text: Endless dreams, eternal peace. Isn't that better than reality?

say:22:1660218015:0.text: This isn't peace. It's a lie. I have people waiting for me. I'm going back!
say:22:1660218015:0.source_cn: 这太荒唐了，我必须回去，父亲和商会不能没有我！

say:24:1660218016:0.text: I'm tired of dragging my feet through endless years, sure, but I'd still choose that over living in a fabricated dream.
say:24:1660218016:0.source_cn: 虽然我厌弃这无穷无尽的岁月，但也好过沉溺于编造出来的虚无。

say:26:1660218017:0.text: I... I want to go home to the Dark Forest. People there need my help!
say:26:1660218017:0.source_cn: 我、我想回薄暮丛林，继续帮助大家！

say:33:1660218021:0.text: You have whole new lives here. New identities. New friends. Isn't that worth something?
say:33:1660218021:0.source_cn: 你们在梦境里有新的身份和新的朋友，这很有趣。

say:34:1660218022:0.text: Even when you fight, no one gets hurt. That's the kind of world people dream of.
say:34:1660218022:0.source_cn: 你们在梦境里就算争吵也不会受伤，这很和平。

say:35:1660218023:1.text: We'll protect this place with everything we've got!
say:35:1660218023:1.source_cn: 我们会守护这场梦境，绝对！

say:36:1660218024:1.text: This dream isn't going anywhere. Not if we can help it!
say:36:1660218024:1.source_cn: 这场梦境不能被破坏，绝对！

choice:30:1:2.source_cn: 你们快解除这个梦境，让大家醒过来

choice:16:0:1.female: You shouldn't be wielding this kind of power.

choice:16:1:2.male: So who helped you pull this off?
choice:16:1:2.female: So who helped you pull this off?
